high_level_description: stc brand style, a digital wallpaper with flowing turquoise, white, and golden ribbon shapes forming a wave-like pattern.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A light blue gradient background that darkens toward the edges, with soft dreamy transitions between colors.

elements.desc: Flowing, spiral-like ribbon shapes in turquoise, white, and golden tones sweeping from the bottom right to the top left of the frame.
Four diamond-shaped icons in green, purple, orange, and blue in the bottom left corner.
Purple Arabic text below the diamond icons.
